# Metrics — AI Finance Controller

Every number here is regenerated by `python scripts/run_reconciliation.py
--dataset <name>`; do not edit by hand. Datasets and their answer keys live in
`data/datasets/` and are produced deterministically by `finance_controller.synth`.

## Definitions

| Metric | Definition |
| --- | --- |
| **Auto‑match rate** | entries placed in a match group / total entries |
| **Precision** | correctly‑matched entry *pairs* / all predicted pairs |
| **Recall** | correctly‑matched pairs / all true pairs in the answer key |
| **F1** | harmonic mean of precision and recall |
| **Exception‑category accuracy** | exceptions whose category equals `truth.json` / total labelled exceptions |
| **Replay stable** | a second run produces an identical groups+exceptions fingerprint |
| **Deterministic / structural / resolver share** | fraction of groups whose strongest edge came from each stage |

Precision/recall are computed on **pairs** (both entries in the same group), not
on whole groups — a single giant group can't inflate the score.

## Latest run — offline heuristic resolver (no LLM key)

| dataset | entries | groups | auto‑match | precision | recall | F1 | exc‑cat accuracy | replay | engine |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| clean | 125 | 30 | 100.0% | 1.000 | 1.000 | 1.000 | n/a | stable | ~15 ms |
| realistic | 352 | 82 | 98.3% | 1.000 | 1.000 | 1.000 | 100.0% (6/6) | stable | ~150 ms |
| messy | 466 | 111 | 97.2% | 1.000 | 1.000 | 1.000 | 100.0% (13/13) | stable | ~160 ms |

Stage mix (realistic): 2% deterministic‑only groups, 95% structural, **2%
resolver** — the resolver pairs the off‑gateway transfers that carry no shared
identifier.

Money summary (realistic): reconciled ₹2,01,394 · in transit ₹3,009 ·
**recoverable ₹9,053** · unrecorded ₹1,981.

The entries that are *not* auto‑matched are the deliberately injected anomalies —
they are supposed to land in the exception queue, and every one is categorised
correctly.

## What each benchmark contains

`synth.py` injects, with a ground‑truth label for each:

| Scenario | clean | realistic | messy | expected outcome |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| clean 4‑way flow (fee + 18% GST, T+2) | ~28/day | ~7/day | ~6/day | one `complete` group |
| split batch (3–5 payments → 1 payout) | 1 | 3 | 5 | one group via `split-settlement` |
| merged payout (2 settlements → 1 credit) | 0 | 2 | 4 | one group via `merged-bank-credit` |
| double‑booked ledger entry | 0 | 2 | 5 | `duplicate` exception |
| revenue captured, payout never landed | 0 | 2 | 5 | `payout_overdue` group → recoverable |
| bank credit never booked | 0 | 2 | 5 | `missing_in_ledger` exception |
| payout raised, credit after the window | 1 | 2 | 4 | `awaiting_payout` group |
| bank deducted an extra charge | 0 | 2 | 4 | `fee_mismatch` exception (settlement named) |
| off‑gateway transfer + booked entry (no shared id) | 0 | 2 | 3 | paired by the **residual resolver** (amount + date + counterparty name) |

## Targets (for the pitch)

| Metric | Target | Current |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Precision | ≥ 0.99 | 1.000 |
| Recall | ≥ 0.95 | 1.000 |
| F1 | ≥ 0.97 | 1.000 |
| Auto‑match rate | ≥ 0.90 | 0.97–1.00 |
| Exception‑category accuracy | ≥ 0.80 | 1.000 |
| Replay stability | 1.0 | 1.0 |
| Engine latency (≈500 entries) | < 1 s | ~0.18 s |

## Honesty notes

- Scores above use the **heuristic** resolver — the weaker of the two backends —
  so they are a floor, not a best case. With an `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` the LLM
  resolver handles the residual tail; `resolver_mode`, token count and USD cost
  are reported on every run.
- The benchmark is synthetic. It models the fee/GST/T+2 structure and eight
  real reconciliation failure modes, but it is not a substitute for a merchant's
  actual month. FX‑adjusted international settlements are **not** modelled yet —
  they need the Razorpay settlement‑recon report as a join key (future work).
- Every headline number in the pitch is tied to a committed dataset and is
  reproducible with one command.
